index.title: Research a Topic
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Last 30 Days Researcher. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Research a Topic. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person used a chatbot to research a topic by connecting to various online platforms and scraping for information. They used a dedicated chat to ask for input and adjust the search scope and output format.
